title_zh: 向保护区报告近岸受伤鸟并等候

scenario.label_zh: 海岸保护区受伤鸟求助
scenario.goal_zh: 说明受伤鸟的位置，获得保护区派员处理的承诺并决定留在步道上等候

context_zh: 游客致电虚构海岸保护区的工作人员报告可见的受伤鸟。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Ellie
sentences.text: I am in the coastal reserve, near the wooden viewing platform. There is a bird dragging one wing.

sentences.speaker: Warden
sentences.text: Is it on the shore or farther out in the water?

sentences.speaker: Ellie
sentences.text: In the shallow water beside the red marker, about two metres from the shore.

sentences.speaker: Warden
sentences.text: Thank you. Our rescue team is nearby. I will send them to the platform.

sentences.speaker: Ellie
sentences.text: Should I go closer so I can show them?

sentences.speaker: Warden
sentences.text: Please stay on the path. The red marker gives us a clear location, and the team will meet you there.

sentences.speaker: Ellie
sentences.text: Understood. I'll wait on the path by the platform and point it out when they arrive.
